terminal_amendment.actual_timeout: The registered environment cap alone yields censoring. In-game attack timers keep their game progression semantics. Preserve the actual next camera. Start return fitting from the archived behavior value and run two value refits on the applicable trainer fold. GAE at that cap uses the current out-of-fold critic's estimate of the actual next state. Critic RMSE compares truly observed endpoints with the same targets for both models.
